method: Represent every product and interval endpoint as an exact integer in units2^-266.
Start every coordinate at any FP32 value in±2*K*maxOriginalX*maxOriginalDY, a conservative enclosure of pre-event ordinary accumulation.

Before each changed K-ordered coefficient product, permit an arbitrary exact perturbation±2*64*maxOriginalX*maxOriginalDY, then round exact endpoint+product to FP32 RNE. Monotonicity bounds every intervening accumulation.

For an ordinary product p added to an already-representable FP32 a, RN(a+p) is at least as close to a+p as a is, hence abs(RN(a+p)-a)<=2*abs(p). Summing this bound covers all64 unmodified terms between changed coefficients regardless of cancellation.
After the final changed product, permit the full±2*K*maxOriginalX*maxOriginalDY perturbation again. Compare both endpoints with exact BF16 midpoint boundaries; ties remain outside success.
assumptions: Changed coefficient products enter each output accumulator in increasing-K order once per64-K tile, as in the documented A→LDS→WMMA temporal mapping.
FP32 RNE additions/FMA or equivalent one-large-product WMMA accumulation with unmodified small terms; no additional faults, overflow, nonstandard rounding mode, or altered scale.
Scalar bounds, input-byte identity, full fanout and unaligned-address behavior are bound separately. This is a numerical certificate, not observed device execution or original-event assignment.
